Advances: specled.spec_review

Scope expansion #2, named by BOTH graders of specled_-q0q.4 (verifier Notes 1-2, auditor second-grader statement with enlarged carve). specled_-q0q.2 added the 11th append_only code but four of five hand-maintained code mirrors are stale, leaving a live violation of specled.spec_review.triangle_code_classification: the review HTML renders the Decisions/governance row green while a self_authorized_weakening finding is live. Must land before 0.13.0. Full contract in the first comment on this ticket.

comments.text:
CONTRACT (orchestrator-authored; treat as the ticket body)

Deliverable (the auditor's enlarged carve from specled_-q0q.4):
1. lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex:1121-1130 — the Decisions/governance leg's codes: list enumerates only 10 append_only/* codes; add append_only/self_authorized_weakening. Line ~1146 sums finding counts over that list and ~1151 sets passed?: count == 0, so today a live self_authorized_weakening finding renders the governance row green — a violation of specled.spec_review.triangle_code_classification (spec_review.spec.md:234, priority: must). The list is not severity-filtered (no_baseline :info is already in it).
2. test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs:127-138 (@append_only_codes hand catalog) and :157-168 (per-code flip table) — both list 10 codes; the test at :147 titled "the row covers every append_only/* code in the catalog" asserts exhaustiveness against its own stale catalog. Add the 11th code to both, AND make the exhaustiveness claim real: derive the expected code set from the emitters the way test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs already does (grep over lib/), or assert the test catalog equals the implementation-derived set, so a 12th code cannot silently repeat this incident.
3. test/specled_ex/branch_check/severity_integration_test.exs:353-364 — the append_only_codes table under the describe at :339 ("@per_code_defaults covers every finding code emitted by this project") lists 10 rows; add the append_only/self_authorized_weakening => :info row and, same as item 2, tie the exhaustiveness claim to the emitter-derived set if the file idiom allows a minimal way to do it.

Do NOT change the fail-loudly hand-maintained-mirror design philosophy (docs_identifier_lint_test.exs:55-62 defends it) — strengthening the exhaustiveness assertions to compare against the emitter-derived set is the repo-idiomatic fix, not replacing the visible tables.

Spec co-change is AUTHORIZED where the gate forces it: smallest edits to .spec/specs/spec_review.spec.md (and any other subject the branch guard names for these file touches) that keep branch_guard_missing_subject_update green; .spec/realization_hashes.json refresh only if a named binding drifts.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: mix test test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs test/specled_ex/branch_check/severity_integration_test.exs test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs
- Behavior to demonstrate: with a live append_only/self_authorized_weakening finding, the review HTML governance row is NOT passed (flips red). Name the test that proves it and what assertion fails if the code is dropped from the html.ex list again.
- Iteration tier: targeted files + mix spec.check --no-run-commands
- Final tier: bash ./scripts/check_specs.sh run-until-green, plus mix compile --warnings-as-errors, mix test, mix format --check-formatted, mix deps.unlock --check-unused, make xref

Allowed touches:
- lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex (the codes: list entry ONLY)
- test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs
- test/specled_ex/branch_check/severity_integration_test.exs
- .spec/specs/spec_review.spec.md, .spec/specs/implementation_tier.spec.md, .spec/specs/package.spec.md (gate-forced minimal co-change only)
- .spec/realization_hashes.json (binding refresh only if forced)

Out of Scope (files): VERSION, CHANGELOG.md, lib/specled_ex/append_only.ex, lib/specled_ex/overlap.ex, lib/specled_ex/branch_check.ex, docs/**, .spec/decisions/**
Out of Scope (intent): no behavior change beyond the governance row correctly counting the 11th code; no redesign of the review HTML; no new finding codes.

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors; targeted tests; bash ./scripts/check_specs.sh
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted, mix deps.unlock --check-unused, make xref
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket

IMPLEMENTED

Verification stubs flipped: none

Summary: Added append_only/self_authorized_weakening to the Decisions/governance leg codes list so a live finding flips that row red (triangle_code_classification). Extended the hand-maintained catalogs in html_test and severity_integration_test and asserted each equals the AppendOnly emitter-derived set, preserving fail-loudly mirrors. Gate-forced branch-reconciliation notes on spec_review, severity, and config; Spec-Drift trailer for missing_decision_update.

VERIFY: PASS
Session: 63655cb6-965a-48c3-bb59-64da6ce31142
Log: /Users/mz/.claude-personal/projects/-Users-mz-src-specled-ex/63655cb6-965a-48c3-bb59-64da6ce31142.jsonl

Mechanical checks:
- Files touched: 6 — lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex (+1), test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs (+51/-18 net), test/specled_ex/branch_check/severity_integration_test.exs (+30), .spec/specs/spec_review.spec.md (+6), .spec/specs/severity.spec.md (+6), .spec/specs/config.spec.md (+5). .spec/realization_hashes.json NOT touched (no binding drift forced; spec.check passes).
- Files outside Allowed globs: 0. severity.spec.md and config.spec.md are not in the contract's explicit file list but fall under the contract's "any other subject the branch guard names for these file touches" clause — both proven forced below.
- Files matching Out-of-Scope globs: 0. No VERSION, CHANGELOG.md, append_only.ex, overlap.ex, branch_check.ex, docs/**, or .spec/decisions/** in the diff.
- Gate-forced spec touches: both forced, by real-commit counterfactual on a detached HEAD (commit-tree with the file reverted to its b76b48a4 blob, NOT a working-tree revert).
  - severity.spec.md omitted (commit 8d038da9, changed_files=6): `spec.check result=fail tier=branch error_findings=1` with `[ERROR] branch_guard_missing_subject_update test/specled_ex/branch_check/severity_integration_test.exs :: ... impacts subject specs that were not updated: specled.severity`. FORCED.
  - config.spec.md omitted (commit 1c9a0f71, changed_files=6): same shape, `... not updated: specled.config`. FORCED.
  - Minimality: each edit is a prose "Branch reconciliation note" paragraph inserted at the head of the ## Verification section. No requirement, scenario, priority, realized_by, or spec-verification block was altered in any of the three spec files. The idiom is pre-existing in this repo (7 prior occurrences across status/branch_guard/verification/evidence_store/package/implementation_tier specs), and the immediately prior ticket b76b48a4 used the same shape. Forced + minimal.
- Spec-Drift trailer: commit body carries `Spec-Drift: branch_guard_missing_decision_update=info` plus the reason line "Catalog/row mirror only — not durable cross-cutting policy; the v2 budget ADR already records the eleventh code." Counterfactual (commit 3911cd9e — byte-identical tree to b255dbd5, trailer stripped): findings go from `1 (error=0 info=1)` / result=pass to `1 (error=1 info=0)` / `result=fail tier=branch error_findings=1`. The single suppressed finding is branch_guard_missing_decision_update, and that finding's own fix block reads "if it does not, record `Spec-Drift: branch_guard_missing_decision_update=info` as a git trailer on a commit in this range, with a one-line reason in the commit body" — exactly the remedy taken. Suppression is narrow (one code, one finding) and the reason line is present. Ruling: legitimate, not broader than the finding.
- html.ex lib diff: exactly one added line — `append_only/self_authorized_weakening` inserted into the Decisions/governance leg `codes:` ~w sigil at line 1129. Nothing else in lib/ changed. Confirmed the code appears exactly once in lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex, so there is no double-leg attribution.

Semantic checks:
- Headline mutation (governance row): reverted only the html.ex line (leaving the tests intact) and ran `mix test test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs` — 99 tests, exactly 2 failures, both new:
  1. html_test.exs:189 "append_only/self_authorized_weakening flips the 'Decisions / governance' row from passed to failed" — `assert dirty_gov.passed? == false` left: true, right: false. This is the behavioral proof.
  2. html_test.exs:174 "the row covers every append_only/* code in the catalog" — `row_codes == catalog`, "missing from row: [\"append_only/self_authorized_weakening\"]".
  No other test failed, and none of the other 10 per-code flip tests were disturbed. Restored html.ex; suite back to 99/0.
- Exhaustiveness assertions: the expected set is genuinely implementation-derived, not a second hand copy. Both new "matches emitters both ways" tests read lib/specled_ex/append_only.ex source and scan `~r/code:\s*"(append_only\/[a-z0-9_]+)"/` into a MapSet, then assert set equality against the hand catalog (html_test.exs:34-41 helper + :164; severity_integration_test.exs:394-410). Verified the derivation is complete and exact: append_only.ex emits 11 distinct append_only/* codes, all as string literals at lines 377-558; the only other `code:` occurrence is the typespec `code: String.t()` at line 36, which the regex cannot match. No append_only/* code is emitted anywhere else in lib/ (branch_check.ex:26-36 is the severity default map, html.ex:3508 is a prefix filter).
  Mutation-proved: added a 12th emitter `code: "append_only/verifier_probe_twelfth"` to append_only.ex and ran both files — exactly 2 failures, one per catalog, each naming `missing from table/catalog: ["append_only/verifier_probe_twelfth"]`. A 12th code cannot land silently. Restored.
  The chain is closed end to end: emitters -> html_test catalog (:164) -> governance row codes (:174, now set-equality, upgraded from the old one-way `for code <- catalog, assert code in gov.codes` that could not catch an extra row code) -> per-code flip table (:187, now iterating @append_only_codes instead of its own duplicated literal list). The severity leg is emitters -> @append_only_codes (:354) -> @per_code_defaults source check (:378). The visible hand-maintained tables were preserved, so the fail-loudly design that docs_identifier_lint_test.exs:55-62 defends is intact.
- Requirements coverage: specled.spec_review.triangle_code_classification (spec_review.spec.md:234, priority: must — "`append_only/*` findings shall flip a dedicated 'Decisions / governance' checklist row") is covered by test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs:189 (the generated per-code test for append_only/self_authorized_weakening), and that file is wired into the subject's own verification block as an `execute: true` command entry that explicitly `covers: specled.spec_review.triangle_code_classification`. Would fail if: the `append_only/self_authorized_weakening` entry is dropped from the html.ex codes list — demonstrated above, `dirty_gov.passed?` returns true where the test demands false.
  Seams: the tests call `Html.build_sync_checks/1` directly with a synthetic `triage/2` fixture map (html_test.exs:15-29) rather than driving `mix spec.review` end to end. I checked the seam is faithful: `findings_by_code` is built in lib/specled_ex/review.ex:503-506 as `Enum.group_by(findings, & &1["code"]) |> Map.new(fn {k, v} -> {k, length(v)} end)`, so the real keys are the same raw code strings the fixture uses. The fixture pins `affected_subject_count: 1`, which matters because the governance row is `vacuous?: triage.affected_subject_count == 0` — pre-existing design, not introduced here, and a live self_authorized_weakening finding implies an affected subject.
- No other spec_review must regressed: `mix test test/specled_ex/review_test.exs test/mix/tasks/spec_review_task_test.exs` (the subject's other execute:true command target) — 34 tests, 0 failures. html_test.exs itself 99/0. `mix spec.check --no-run-commands --base b76b48a4` result=pass, validate errors=0 warnings=0.
- Verification stubs flipped: none. Confirmed by grepping the .spec/ half of the diff for added/removed `execute:` lines — zero hits.
- Intent-level scope concerns: none. The lib change is the single codes-list entry; no review-HTML redesign, no new finding codes, no severity change (branch_check.ex already carried `append_only/self_authorized_weakening => :info` from specled_-q0q.4 and was not touched here). The test changes are catalog extension plus assertion strengthening; the one structural change (local `append_only_codes` var promoted to `@append_only_codes` module attribute in severity_integration_test) is what lets the new equality test reference the same table, and the existing per-code generated tests still run over it.
- Targeted verification: PASS. Commands run in /Users/mz/src/specled_ex-governance-mirrors: `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` (clean), `mix format --check-formatted` (clean), `mix test test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs test/specled_ex/branch_check/severity_integration_test.exs test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs` (143 tests, 0 failures), `mix test test/specled_ex/review_test.exs test/mix/tasks/spec_review_task_test.exs` (34 tests, 0 failures), `mix spec.check --no-run-commands --base b76b48a4` (result=pass).
- Working tree restored after mutations: clean. `git status --short` shows only the pre-existing untracked `?? .grok/sandbox.toml`; `git diff HEAD --stat` empty; HEAD back on branch specled_-q0q.5/governance-mirrors at b255dbd585b807c3dcf40aa638867a2fe92f959a. All four counterfactual commits (3911cd9e, 8d038da9, 1c9a0f71 and the detached checkouts) were unreferenced detached objects and left no branch or tree residue.
- Full-suite verification: not run by verifier (by design)

Verdict: PASS

Notes (advisory only, no action required for this ticket):
1. The emitter derivation is a regex over source text of one hardcoded path, `lib/specled_ex/append_only.ex`. It is correct today and it does fail on a 12th code in that file, which is the incident this ticket was about. It would not catch an append_only/* code introduced in a different module, and it depends on the literal `code: "..."` spelling (an emitter built via a helper or a module attribute would slip past). Worth knowing if AppendOnly is ever split.
2. Both new tests duplicate the same ~6-line regex-scan block rather than sharing a helper. Deduplicating would need a test-support module; the duplication is deliberate given the two files are otherwise independent, but it is now a third place to update if the emitter spelling changes.
3. The contract described the target idiom as "the way test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs already does (grep over lib/)". That file actually documents the opposite for its own allowlist — its docstring (lines ~58-62) says `specled.decision.doc_identifier_lint_spec_corpus` rejects deriving the code set by reflection over lib/, and keeps a vetted hand allowlist on purpose. The implementer took the contract's second option (hand table asserted equal to the implementation-derived set), which preserves the visible fail-loudly tables and satisfies the stated goal. No conflict with the ADR as far as I can tell, since the ADR constrains the docs lint's allowlist rather than these mirrors — but if that reading is wrong, the assertion style is the thing to revisit, not the catalogs.
